newsitem.title: UK: Oasis win MTV top group award.
newsitem.headline: Oasis win MTV top group award.

text.p: Oasis, the bad boys of Britpop, on Thursday were picked as the best group of the year at a star-studded MTV awards ceremony.

But Britain's bigggest group since the Beatles were not there to receive their award at London's Alexandra Palace. Oasis, who are busy making their third album, almost split up after a row between warring brothers Liam and Noel Gallagher.
Oasis, who have sworn, spat and got drunk at previous award ceremonies, sent a message to their fans saying: "Keep the faith. Live Forever."
U.S. band Smashing Pumpkins took the Best Rock Award but said they felt "really bad because Oasis should have won this".
They were given their award by racing driver Jacques Villeneuve and supermodel Helena Christiansen.
The MTV Europe award for best male vocalist went to George Michael who performed at the show and said after he was picked: "I am really touched by this."
